documents.population: International applicants to bachelor's programmes (all taught in Chinese), including Computer Science & Technology
documents.notes: Institute for International Students, Bachelor's Programs page. The page's dates are the 2026 cycle's (CSCA scores due 15 May 2026; 'Catalog of Undergraduate Programs 2026'); the CSCA requirement applies 'starting from the 2026/2027 academic year', a policy start, not the list's year. Not drafted (no vocabulary kind): HSK certificate (HSK 5, 180+; waived for 12-year Chinese education in Malaysia/Singapore). Optional standardized tests (A-Level, AP, ACT, IB, SAT, AST) are in the page but not drafted because entrance_test is already the required CSCA report.
